entry.title: Resolution 571 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO WEGO! FOUNDATION, INC., TO ASSIST WITH EXPENSES FOR THE 2026 HAWAI‘I INTERNATIONAL FUTSAL CUP

Transfers $1,000 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 9)

Status: — → Adopted
